articles.summary: Drowning in Docker clutter? Learn how to use docker system prune to reclaim valuable disk space and remove all those old artifacts that are hogging your machine.
articles.title: Tidy up with docker system prune

articles.summary: In this article, we explain what Docker buildx is, how it's different from docker build, the extra functionality it offers, and when you should use it.
articles.title: Docker buildx explained

articles.summary: Depot GitHub Actions runners with GPUs are now generally available for Depot Managed. This allows you to run the full data plane in your own AWS sub account with your own set of GPU resources.
articles.title: GPUs now available for Depot GitHub Actions runners

articles.summary: When your CI pipelines are slow, you can only optimize so much. Bottlenecks in CPU, Network, Memory, and Disk I/O can all contribute to slow CI pipelines. Let's take a look at how disk I/O can be a bottleneck in GitHub Actions.
articles.title: Uncovering Disk I/O Bottlenecks in GitHub Actions

articles.summary: We love GitHub Actions, but the default runners are slow and expensive. We benchmarked the performance of GitHub Actions runners against Depot runners and found that Depot runners are 2x faster and half the cost.
articles.title: Comparing GitHub Actions and Depot runners for 2x faster builds
